style_description: Soft abstract light on a near-black ground. Large blurred wedges, beams, and ovals, as if flat colored shapes were thrown out of focus. A bright inner color wears a darker rim: gold with a red edge, cyan with an orange edge, blue with a purple edge. Dark gaps stay open between the shapes. Light moves on a diagonal, tapers to a point, or pools in a soft oval. Some marks are small and almost sharp: a short glowing underline, a thin horizontal connector, a vertical tick, an elbow line. Nothing is a picture of an object. No letters, no icons, no people, no photorealism, no 3D gloss. The frame crops the light so it bleeds off the edge. The same family is reused as page atmosphere, as a small emphasis under type, or as a simple diagram of light splitting, meeting, or being pinched. One graphic uses only the pairs it already has. A single mark uses one pair. The full set is the family, not the default fill.
